_notice: SYNTHETIC EVALUATION EXAMPLES written by the development team. They are NOT real resident reports and NOT real-world evidence of accuracy. The same team wrote the word lists, so results on this set are optimistic. 'expected_priority' lists every level the team considered acceptable. isiXhosa examples still need checking by a fluent speaker.
